hints.title: Subsequence Extraction and Merging
hints.text: Extract maximal length i and length k minus i subsequences from the two arrays and merge them lexicographically.

hints.title: Monotonic Subsequence Selection
hints.text: Use a decreasing monotonic stack to extract the largest subsequence of length count from a single array.

hints.title: Lexicographical Suffix Merging
hints.text: Iterate i from max(0, k - len(nums2)) to min(k, len(nums1)). Extract max subsequences of lengths i and k - i using monotonic stack. Merge the two arrays by greedily comparing remaining suffixes. Track the maximum merged result.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal partition decomposition combining monotonic stacks with suffix comparison merging.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subsequences of lengths i and k - i requires exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic stack extracts optimal single-array subsequences in linear O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use full suffix comparison when merging equal leading digits between the two lists.
